description: Sample users of an app: invented clients, players or members so its back office looks full and real without showing anyone real (the students of a yoga studio, the clients of a dog groomer, the players of a ranking): an example app's screenshots, or a studio showing its client how the app will look with people in it, best in its pre (env "pre"). Remove them all with removeAll before the app opens to the public. They have no account: nobody signs in as them and no mail is sent to them; their address ends in @ejemplo.neblla.app. They count in no quota, no statistic, no «write to everyone» and no export. action "list"; "create" { name, email? (…@ejemplo.neblla.app, made from the name when left out), photo? (https image), language? ("es") } → { user } (its id is their user id in the app); "update" { user, name?, photo? (null takes it off), language? }; "remove" { user } and "removeAll" (with everything of theirs: bookings, notes, messages). What they do, so the back office shows it: "book" { user, set, slot, for?, party? } (a place in a session; a service paid at booking is taken as paid, no money moves), "buy" { user, productId, amount?, until? } (what the product gives — credits of a pack, a standing place in a repetition — with no payment and nothing in Ventas), "message" { user, text } (they write to the business in the Buzón), "chat" { user, set, slot, text } (they write in the chat of a session they booked). Notes on their card: neblla_business userNote { user, text }; credits by hand: neblla_credits adjust { owner: user }. The screenshots of an example show its sample users only.

env.description: "pro" (the published app) or "pre" (its test copy: pre's services and config, on pre's data, its own unless it plays with pro's). Left out: where the app is, its chosen environment (neblla_promote "status": target, "pro" by default). The pre id (_<id>) as appId is the same as env "pre"

user.description: The sample user's id (create answers it)

name: neblla_sample_users
